purpose: Versioned eligibility, medical triage and annual premium rate grid for SecureLife Health Shield Plus. The employee reviews evidence and records the underwriting decision.

rules.rule_text: This individual health product accepts entry ages 18 through 60 and the configured annual cover options only.
rules.source_quote: This individual health product accepts entry ages 18 through 60 and the configured annual cover options only.
rules.action: Check entry age and the chosen cover against the rate grid.

rules.rule_text: Declared hypothyroidism requires review of the medical declaration, thyroid laboratory report and consultation record. An employee must select a medical rating class; declarations alone do not establish clinical stability.
rules.source_quote: Declared hypothyroidism requires review of the medical declaration, thyroid laboratory report and consultation record. An employee must select a medical rating class; declarations alone do not establish clinical stability.
rules.action: Review the medical declaration, laboratory report and consultation before choosing a medical class.

rules.rule_text: STANDARD and CONTROLLED_CONDITION are permitted product rating classes. SPECIALIST_REVIEW requires referral and produces no premium. An unlisted declared condition requires specialist review.
rules.source_quote: STANDARD and CONTROLLED_CONDITION are permitted product rating classes. SPECIALIST_REVIEW requires referral and produces no premium. An unlisted declared condition requires specialist review.
rules.condition: The employee selects the medical rating class
rules.applies_when: The employee selects the medical rating class
rules.action: Use STANDARD only without declared conditions; use CONTROLLED_CONDITION after evidence review or refer for specialist assessment.

rules.rule_text: Use the residence state documented in the application to select the configured zone; Karnataka maps to SOUTH_URBAN for this product.
rules.source_quote: Use the residence state documented in the application to select the configured zone; Karnataka maps to SOUTH_URBAN for this product.
rules.action: Map the documented state to the configured rating zone.

rules.rule_text: Independent identity and address verification, contact details and recorded consent evidence must be resolved by employee review before issuance.
rules.source_quote: Independent identity and address verification, contact details and recorded consent evidence must be resolved by employee review before issuance.
rules.condition: Before employee approval or issuance consideration
rules.applies_when: Before employee approval or issuance consideration
rules.action: Resolve identity, address, contact and recorded consent evidence; retain the reviewed references.

rules.rule_text: Previous insurer confirmation is required when continuity or portability benefits are requested. An employee may record why this requirement is not applicable.
rules.source_quote: Previous insurer confirmation is required when continuity or portability benefits are requested. An employee may record why this requirement is not applicable.
rules.condition: Continuity or portability benefits are requested
rules.applies_when: Continuity or portability benefits are requested
rules.action: Review previous coverage evidence and record the applicability of continuity conditions.

rules.rule_text: Annual premium before tax equals the age-and-cover base premium multiplied by the configured zone, medical and tobacco factors, rounded half up to two decimal places. Tax and issuance are separate.
rules.source_quote: Annual premium before tax equals the age-and-cover base premium multiplied by the configured zone, medical and tobacco factors, rounded half up to two decimal places. Tax and issuance are separate.
rules.condition: An indicative annual health premium is requested
rules.applies_when: An indicative annual health premium is requested
rules.action: Select one age-and-cover base row and multiply by the configured regional, medical and tobacco factors; round half up to two decimals.

rules.rule_text: The product supports employee consideration only after rating inputs and policy evidence have been reviewed. Outstanding verification requirements produce a request-information recommendation. Only an authorized employee records the final decision.
rules.source_quote: The product supports employee consideration only after rating inputs and policy evidence have been reviewed. Outstanding verification requirements produce a request-information recommendation. Only an authorized employee records the final decision.
rules.condition: The review reaches the recommendation stage
rules.applies_when: The review reaches the recommendation stage
rules.action: Keep unresolved requirements open; an employee records the decision with the supporting evidence and rationale.

tax_configuration.note: Tax treatment must be confirmed separately; this prototype calculates an annual premium before tax.
